item.title: Show HN: I built a DNS resolver from scratch in Rust – no DNS libraries
item.description:
📝 numa (or http://localhost:5380) Set as system DNS: Platform Install Uninstall macOS sudo numa install sudo numa uninstall Linux sudo numa install sudo numa uninstall Windows numa install (admin) + reboot numa uninstall (admin) + reboot On macOS and Linux, numa runs as a system service (launchd/systemd). Enable with numa lan on. numa resolution without installing anything.
🔗 Read more: https://github.com/razvandimescu/numa
